description: Baugher: in 2010 was on display outside the FAA facility at Nashua New Hampshire after Marine service with VMA-332 VMA-225 VMA-224 and VMA-324 and test work at China Lake and Point Mugu. An OSM way tagged Douglas A-4 Skyhawk in the current extract fixes it at 42.73454 -71.48009 - good currency. Aerial Visuals calls it simply "A-4".
